caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with an octagonal top surface. The table is shown in a three-quarter view, revealing four ornately turned legs and a single drawer at the front. The drawer is adorned with two brass keyhole escutcheons and round pulls. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, with lighter highlights on the edges and darker shading under the tabletop and around the legs, emphasizing the dimensionality of the piece. Each leg is bulbous in the center, tapering toward the ends, and connected near the floor by a decorative shaped stretcher that meets at a small central sphere. The table rests on four bun feet. The table is centrally positioned on a beige or off-white background, and the drawing is outlined by a thin, rectangular pencil border.
title: Slate-top Table
